name: urban-threadz
description: A responsive frontend e-commerce website for a clothing brand — featuring product listings, cart functionality, and a clean, modern UI. Built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

paragraphs: A premium frontend e-commerce website for Urban Threadz — a streetwear and premium fashion brand offering shirts, t-shirts, and pants collections. The site delivers a bold, editorial shopping experience with product showcases and direct WhatsApp-based ordering.

Urban Threadz is a stylish, story-driven storefront built to showcase a curated clothing collection with a strong brand identity. The site combines editorial design, product highlights, customer testimonials, and a frictionless ordering flow — all without requiring a backend or checkout system.
features: 🏠 Editorial hero section with brand tagline, legacy stats (25+ Years, 10K+ Customers, 15+ Collections), and a scrolling marquee banner
👕 Shirts Collection — Premium, Checks, Linen, Formal, and Polo shirts with size options (S–XXL)
👔 Premium T-Shirts — Long-Sleeve, Chinese Collar, Plain, Down Shoulder, and Premium tees
👖 Pants Collection — Black/Blue Jeans, Cargo, Formal, and Plain pants with size options (34–40)
🏷️ Product badges highlighting Bestseller, New, Trending, and Hot items
